settings.title: Personal Information We Collect

settings.title: Data Retention Policy
settings.content:
Information is kept for 90 days to 2 years after user accounts remain idle, or as long as necessary for stated purposes. Extended retention may occur for:

  • Legal compliance
  • Fraud prevention
  • Enforcement of rights

Anonymous aggregate data may be retained indefinitely for analytics purposes.

settings.title: Your Rights
settings.content:
You have the right to:

  • Access, correct, or erase your personal data
  • Obtain copies of your data
  • Restrict or object to data processing
  • Request data portability to another entity
  • Withdraw consent at any time
  • Lodge complaints with relevant authorities
  • Opt out of direct marketing and profiling

settings.title: Security Measures
settings.content: We employ reasonable security measures to prevent loss, misuse, or unauthorized alteration of your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Please note: Refusing to provide necessary data may prevent access to certain services. For questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at info@3deltadental.com.
